evidence_classes.measured-RTL: Observed in an RTL simulation of this repository's RTL (Verilator or Icarus) against a golden; reduced vehicles unless stated.
evidence_classes.measured-physical: Read from an ASAP7 synthesis, place-and-route or DFT run of this repository's RTL (predictive 7 nm PDK; not silicon).
evidence_classes.measured-quality: Measured model quality or acceptance on real weights, on a GPU, under an emulation of the deployment arithmetic.
evidence_classes.measured-gpu: Measured by this project on GPU hardware (microbenchmarks, application runs).
evidence_classes.model: An analytical, specification, calibrated or design-point model evaluated by a repository tool; RTL-calibrated where stated. Not a measurement of a chip.
evidence_classes.third-party: A figure published by someone else and carried into a record as a cited input.
